adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#7
adds.text: Blake pressures BB Urich into cutting eyewitness accounts of Daredevil from her report, so the task force gets the credit for stopping Muse.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: As Daredevil, the hero Blake scrubs from the Muse story.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's aide, who scrubs Daredevil from the Muse story.
adds.evidence: Art for Art's Sake (S1#7): on Fisk's order Blake makes sure the AVTF gets credit for stopping Muse even though Daredevil intervened, and threatens BB into removing eyewitness mentions of Daredevil from her blog. Indirect: no face-to-face scene.

adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#1
adds.text: At Cherry's retirement party, Josie pours Foggy and Kirsten drinks from the aged bottle of O'Melveny's she keeps behind the bar.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Bar owner who pours Foggy her aged O'Melveny's.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A regular she serves her aged O'Melveny's at Cherry's party.
adds.evidence: Heaven's Half Hour (S1#1): Josie hosts Cherry's party; Foggy tells Kirsten that Josie keeps an aged bottle of O'Melveny's behind the bar, which she then serves to them, shortly before Bullseye's attack.

adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
adds.text: Karen asks Frank to keep Matt safe after Bullseye escapes, and he does it as a favor to her. When they part, she tells him she knows he cares.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who asks Frank to keep Matt safe.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Guards Matt as a favor to Karen.
adds.evidence: Straight to Hell (S1#9): Page called Castle and asked him to protect Murdock; she picks them up after the apartment fight, takes them to Castle's hideout, and on leaving says she knows he cares; he replies he did a favor for her.

adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
adds.text: Frank vows to put a bullet in Fisk's head. After Fisk's task force captures him at Red Hook, Fisk keeps him caged in his dungeon there.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The mayor who keeps Frank caged at Red Hook.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A vigilante Fisk keeps caged at Red Hook.
adds.evidence: Straight to Hell (S1#9): Castle tells Murdock he would put a bullet in Kingpin's head; the AVTF captures him at Red Hook and he is kept chained in a cage in Fisk's dungeon, watching as Fisk and Vanessa walk past the cages.

adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#8
adds.text: Josie invites Matt into her closed bar for a drink and tells him Foggy ordered O'Melveny's on the night he died, which shows Matt that Foggy was celebrating a win.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A regular she invites in for a drink after the bar closes.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Bar owner who tells Matt what Foggy drank on his last night.
adds.evidence: Isle of Joy (S1#8): Josie invites Murdock into the shuttered Josie's Bar, pours O'Melveny's and tells him Foggy requested it the night of his death; Murdock realizes Foggy expected to win the Cafaro case.

owner_calls.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
owner_calls.question: Add a Born Again S1 stage for Josie and Karen? In S1#1 Josie hosts Cherry's party and leads the toast with Karen in the room, and in S1#9 Josie's Bar (Josie credited) becomes the resistance's home where Daredevil talks with Karen and addresses his allies, but no direct Josie-Karen exchange is documented.
options: friend at Daredevil: Born Again S1#9: Josie opens her bar to Karen and Daredevil as they gather allies against Fisk
owner_calls.evidence: Josie's Bar page: 'Home of the Resistance' section cites DDBA109; Straight to Hell credits list Josie; plot: Daredevil talks to Page at Josie's Bar and addresses allies there.
